with `n` = qword `[r8]` and `p` = qword `[r8+8]`, returns in `xmm0` the float `00861F14(dot(rdx, rdx))` times -(dot(`rcx` - `p`, `n`) / dot(`rdx`, `n`)), each dot product over the floats `+0`/`+4`/`+8`, the sign flipped by `xorps` with `01CEBDA0`

with `f` = qword `[rcx+0x10]` + signed word `dx`*0x20 and `N` = its floats `+0`/`+4`/`+8`, sets the vector at `r9` to (0, 0, 0, 1.0); for each corner `i` of the three words at `f+0x10` (next corner (`i`+1) mod 3, vertices of 0x10 bytes at qword `[rcx+8]`) it calls `00202E10(&o, &e, &d)` with `e` = next vertex minus vertex `i` and `d` = the point at `r8` minus vertex `i`, and returns 1 when `dot(N, o)` is never below 0.0; at the first corner where it is, it returns 0 when bit `0x400` of dword `f+0x1c` is set and `i` is 2; otherwise, with `len` = `00861F14(dot(e, e))` and `t` = `dot(e, d)` / `len`, it takes `d` minus `e`*`t`/`len` (minus nothing when `t` is not above 0, minus `e` when `t` is not below `len`), adds the floats of face `s` = signed word `f+0x16+i*2` to `N` when `s` is not negative, and stores `N` scaled by `00861F14` of the difference's squared length times 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) / `00861F14(dot(N, N))` at `r9` `+0`/`+4`/`+8`, with float `f+0xc` at `+0xc`, returning 1; the frame carries the stack cookie (`01F44830`, checked by `00808C40`)
returns in `xmm0` the dot product of (`rcx` - `r8`) with `rdx` over the floats `+0`/`+4`/`+8`
